title: Change the details on a tradesperson certificate
summary: You can update your tradesperson certificate address or contact details online if your current email or mobile phone number is recorded with Building Commission NSW.
intro:
You can update your tradesperson certificate address or contact details online if your current email address or mobile phone number is recorded with Building Commission NSW.

To find your tradesperson certificate number and details, visit Verify NSW.

### Change of name

To change your name on your certificate take a copy of your change of name document (such as a marriage certificate) to a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: Your current email address or mobile phone number must be recorded with Building Commission NSW.
what_you_need: Your new address or contact details
A copy of your change of name document (such as a marriage certificate) (if changing name)

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to update your details.
download and complete the Notification of Change of Address form – PDF
submit it by email to the address on the form or by visiting a service centre.

faqs.q: How can I find my tradesperson certificate number and details?
faqs.a: Visit Verify NSW to find your tradesperson certificate number and details.

faqs.q: How do I change my name on my tradesperson certificate?
faqs.a: Take a copy of your change of name document (such as a marriage certificate) to a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What do I need to change my details?
faqs.a: You need your name and licence number, and your new address or contact details.
